claim: SEC alleges FTX customer assets were diverted to Alameda Research.
SEC alleges Alameda received special treatment on FTX, including a virtually unlimited customer-funded line of credit and exemptions from risk controls.
SEC alleges FTT was used as collateral and that Ellison manipulated FTT price to support the stated value of Alameda collateral.
SEC alleges FTX software code created a mechanism that allowed customer funds to be diverted to Alameda.
SEC complaint records allegations of large Alameda loans to senior FTX executives and related real-estate spending.
SEC alleges additional customer funds were directed to Alameda even as FTX could no longer make customers whole.
A congressional record documents that the House investigation had collected responsive FTX and SEC documents and interviewed witnesses by May 10, 2023.
The SEC complaints describe the alleged scheme as spanning from at least May 2019 through November 2022.
